reasons.plausibility: Using SPS to lower the sintering temperature of ZrB2 and achieve improved densification aligns well with established field‐assisted sintering science.
reasons.testability: A direct head‐to‐head comparison with conventionally sintered ZrB2, measuring density, microstructure, strength, and corrosion resistance, provides a clear and decisive test.
reasons.usefulness: Demonstrating a viable route to reduce sintering temperature and improve ceramic quality is highly relevant and beneficial for advancing ZrB2 in demanding applications.
